name: WhatSThis_14
short_caption: The robot slightly rotates its forearms outward and opens its palms in a subtle gesture of questioning or presenting.
movement_description: From a neutral standing posture, the robot gently lifts its forearms and rotates its wrists outward to present open palms toward the viewer. Its head remains centered, facing forward, with a very slight forward tilt of the upper torso. The movement concludes as the robot slowly lowers its arms back to the sides, returning to a fully neutral resting position.
